profileLabel: Mildly left economics; weakly mixed social values (low confidence)
summary: Bukidnon 4th District representative with 204 principal-authored bills. Authored the national minimum wage, tax deductions for special needs guardians, exclusion of COMELEC service benefits from income, travel-tax abolition, a ban on promoting online gambling in e-wallets, expanded women's employment anti-discrimination and an anti-dynasty ban.
caveat: Social score nets a vice-regulation bill against a gender-equality bill. Many other bills are tourism declarations.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored the national minimum wage (-2) and tax deductions for special needs guardians (-1), against travel tax abolition (+1). Two issues.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB08081, HB02553, HB08464 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Liberal
social.rationale: Authored expanded women's employment anti-discrimination (+3) and a ban on promoting online gambling in e-wallets (-2, vice regulation). Offsetting, two issues.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB07704, HB00721 (retrieved 2026-11-01)
